# Distinguish a hidden TreeView header from a hidden whole widget

The same Bug 1896009 patch handles header height differently: when the whole tree is hidden, ignore the ResizeObserver zero and keep the cached header height; when only the header is hidden, cache zero because that is its real visible height. The reviewer accepted D210245 and praised the explanatory comments. Current TreeViewTableHeader retains the parent-height guard. This is a narrow layout-state lesson: a zero measurement can mean hidden ancestor or intentionally hidden child, and those states require different cache updates.

Scope: TreeView virtualized layout.

Paths:

- `mail/base/content/widgets/tree-view.mjs`
